title: OpenAI says internal model resolved 100+ open math problems; forms IAS advisory group
summary: OpenAI said an internal model resolved more than 100 additional open problems and set up a nine-member Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI at Princeton's IAS to assess results.
reason: Claimed research-level capability jump; mostly company claim, advisory group confirmed by Terence Tao's blog.

title: Xiaomi open-sources 1T-parameter MiMo-V2.6-Pro under MIT license
summary: Xiaomi released weights, code and a technical report for MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL, a 1.02T-parameter MoE that scored 46 on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index, matching xAI's Grok 4.7.
reason: Strong open-weights release from China spreads capability.

title: UN scientific panel warns safeguards for AI agents are unravelling
summary: The UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI issued its first thematic brief, warning that safeguards for capable AI agents are not keeping pace and invoking a precautionary approach to loss-of-control risk.
reason: First output of UN scientific panel; authoritative global warning on control risk.
